ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) base pixels with sparse, high-intensity (white) localized clusters. Estimated macro-level ratio of 12:1 dark-to-light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast white annular and solid circular clusters (5-20 pixel radii) are distributed across the surface, with a notable concentration of point-source white pixels along the proximal region near the peduncle and the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 40 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1.2 within the central bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe (viewer left) exhibits fine-grained, low-amplitude rhythmic serrations. Right lobe (viewer right) displays a major macro-scale disruption: a large, irregular concave excision (loss of pixel mass) on the outer third, transitioning to coarse, jagged, high-amplitude peaks toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves on the leading edges. Trailing edges follow a primarily concave trajectory, terminating in acute, slightly upward-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast white pixel clusters across both lobes, consistent with localized surface scarring; highest density is observed on the outer distal regions and along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct high-contrast linear pixel disruptions. Notable series of three diagonal parallel white lines on the mid-left lobe and several vertical micro-scratches near the right lobe notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular semi-circular missing section on the outer trailing edge of the right lobe lobes, characterized by jagged, non-uniform pixel boundaries indicating significant prior structural loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'donut-hole' morphology in several white scar clusters where a dark center is preserved within a high-intensity white ring.
